# Dependencies

<!-- Generated by Tools/dependencies.py. Do not edit; edit the script and rerun it. -->

Inventory of everything xlua-ng vendors, builds with or runs on. "Latest" was checked on 2026-10-15.
A machine-readable CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM with the same components is in [sbom.cdx.json](sbom.cdx.json).

Regenerate with `python3 Tools/dependencies.py`; CI can run `python3 Tools/dependencies.py --check`.
Rows for GitHub Actions, runner labels, the Unity matrix, mise tools, pnpm and the docs npm packages
are read from the repository on every run. Everything else is data in the script.

Status values: **current**: latest release, or the newest still-supported one in its line; **behind**: a newer release exists; **EOL**: upstream no longer maintains this release or series; **deprecated**: superseded or abandoned upstream, still works; **unknown**: not verified (see note).

Summary: 22 current, 22 behind, 5 EOL, 2 deprecated, 11 unknown (62 components).

## First-party code (not dependencies)

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `Assets/XLua/Src` | C# bridge and code generator (Unity) |
| `General/Src` | Standalone tools: XLuaGenerate, XLuaHotfixInject, FilesSignature, KeyPairsGen |
| `build/xlua.c, build/i64lib.*, build/memory_leak_checker.c` | Native bridge, int64 library, leak checker |
| `build/CMakeLists.txt, build/make_*, build/luac` | Native build entry points |
| `WebGLPlugins/xlua.c, i64lib.*, perflib.c` | WebGL glue next to the Lua 5.3.4 copy |
| `Assets/Plugins/WebGL, Assets/Plugins/iOS/HotfixFlags.cpp` | Platform glue |
| `Assets/XLua/Resources/**/*.lua.txt` | Lua helper modules (util, tdr, profiler, memory) |
| `build/lua-*/ patches` | xLua changes to vendored Lua, listed in build/LUA_PATCHES.md |

xLua itself is MIT licensed (Tencent); see [LICENSE.TXT](LICENSE.TXT) for the third-party notices.
